longName_note: Confirmed via field-attributes-and-email-check.json that the Name input has an explicit maxlength=80 HTML attribute - the 80-char readback is genuine, deliberate length enforcement, not an absence of a limit. The 2000-char fill attempt was silently capped to 80 characters by the browser respecting maxlength during input. Remaining finding: at 80 unbroken characters, the greeting header has no truncation/ellipsis handling and overflows - a minor display/UX issue, not a data-integrity or validation bug.
